title: Affine spectrum inverse derived counit equation
statement: Let $g\prime:X\prime\to X$ be a morphism of affine schemes [def-pc-scheme], with derived categories chosen [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $P$ be a K-flat complex on $X$ [def-pc-kflat-complex], $P_g=(g\prime)^*P$ and $P_0=j^*P$ termwise, where $j=X.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$ and $j\prime=X\prime.\mathrm{isoSpec}^{-1}$. Assume the pinned pullback counits $c$ for $g\prime$ at $P$ and $c_0$ for $g_0\prime=\operatorname{Spec}(g\prime.\mathrm{appTop})$ at $P_0$ are invertible [def-pc-single-complex-base-change-stalk-condition]. Let $a$ be affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso(gprime) [def-pc-affine-spectrum-derived-coordinates], $e_j$ and $e_{j\prime}$ the exact isoPullbackComplexCounitIso [lem-pc-iso-pullback-stalk-cohomology], and $\alpha:(g_0\prime)^*j^*P\cong(j\prime)^*(g\prime)^*P$ the explicit adjunction-mate chain comparison [def-pc-tensor-pullback-composition-iso]. Then $L(j\prime)^*(c^{-1});a^{-1}_{Q(P)}=e_{j\prime,P_g};Q(\alpha^{-1});c_0^{-1};L(g_0\prime)^*(e_{j,P}^{-1})$. This is an equation of derived morphisms, not a stalk comparison statement; no base morphisms f or g, point, or homology degree is specified.

proof.text: Specialize affineSpectrum_composition_counit_square at gprime and P. Its termwise comparison is definitionally affineSpectrumTensorComplexIso. Unfold isoPullbackComplexCounitIso, quotientCompQhIso and mapHomotopyCategoryFactors: all auxiliary components are identity maps, so the exact complex counit components equal the pinned derived counit components at the homotopy image.

Write the resulting equation as e.hom;c.hom;a.hom=d.hom;b.hom;f.hom, where e and b are functorially mapped counit isomorphisms, a is Q of the termwise comparison, d is the affine derived comparison, c uses hcQ, and f is the exact isoSpec complex counit. Postcompose the desired inverse equation by d.hom;b.hom;f.hom, use the square, and cancel the inverse-hom pairs. The common right factor is an isomorphism and hence mono.

lean.statement:
theorem affineSpectrum_counit_square
    [∀ Y : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    {X X' : Scheme.{u}} [IsAffine X] [IsAffine X'] (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (hP : P.IsAcyclicTensorKFlat)
    (hcP : IsIso ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P)))
    (hcQ : IsIso ((counit (Spec.map g'.appTop)).app
      ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℤ)).obj P)))) :
    let Pg := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P
    let P0 := ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback X.isoSpec.inv).mapHomologicalComplex
      (.up ℤ)).obj P
    (derivedPullback X'.isoSpec.inv).map
        (inv ((counit g').app ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P))) ≫
      (affineSpectrumDerivedPullbackIso g').inv.app (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P) =
    (isoPullbackComplexCounitIso X'.isoSpec.inv).hom.app Pg ≫
      DerivedCategory.Q.map (affineSpectrumTensorComplexIso g' P).inv ≫
      inv ((counit (Spec.map g'.appTop)).app
        ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj P0)) ≫
      (derivedPullback (Spec.map g'.appTop)).map
        ((isoPullbackComplexCounitIso X.isoSpec.inv).inv.app P)
